summary: Futurewave Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company traded on Nasdaq (FWACU/FWAC/FWACR/FWACW), filed an 8-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to combine with Olympian Group Inc. The deal is structured as a reincorporation merger of Parent into Purchaser, followed by a merger of Merger Sub into the Company, leaving Olympian as a wholly owned subsidiary. Principal Shareholders are Northwest Cascade and Credo Universal, with Hantao Cui as representative. Consideration, premium, and close timing are not specified in the excerpt. Watch redemptions, Nasdaq listing, and shareholder approval.
